[[File:Great_Tusks.png|thumb|The Great Tusks]]
{{Quote|Be sure to watch for the Great Tusks, one of this area's most well-known features!|[[Dax Gazaway]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Racer Revenge">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''</ref>}}
The '''Great Tusks''' were a well-known geological feature on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth's]] [[Bright Lands]]. The podracing course [[The Brightlands|Brightlands]] went around it.
